subject: general
question: Which animal was declared the official mascot of 2024 Khelo India Winter Games?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Snow leopard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Snow leopard** is a large cat native to the mountain ranges of Central and South Asia.
 
• It has been listed as **Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List** because the global population is estimated to number fewer than 10,000 mature individuals and continues to decline.
 
• **Snow leopards** are well adapted to their cold environment with thick fur, small rounded ears, and wide, fur-covered paws that act as natural snowshoes.
 
• The species is distributed across **12 countries** including China, India, Mongolia, and Russia.
 
• In India, they are found in the states of **Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, and Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• The snow leopard is an **apex predator** in its habitat, playing a crucial role in maintaining the balance of the ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Yak**__

 __
 
• The **Yak** is a long-haired domesticated bovid found throughout the Himalayan region of the Indian subcontinent, the Tibetan Plateau, and as far north as Mongolia and Russia.
 
• Yaks are used for a variety of purposes including **transportation, milk production, and meat.**
 
 
 
• **Sheep**__
 __
 
• **Sheep** are domesticated ruminant mammals typically kept as livestock. They are raised for their wool, meat, and milk.
 
• There are numerous **breeds of sheep** adapted to various climates around the world.
 
 
 
• **Snow bear**__
 
 
• **Snow bears**, or more commonly known as **Polar bears**, are native to the Arctic region.
 
• They are classified as **marine mammals** because they spend most of their lives on the sea ice of the Arctic Ocean.
 
• Polar bears are **apex predators** in their ecosystem, primarily feeding on seals.
